summary: Frontend-only i18n verification of the Storefront page chrome + 'Page theme' picker + live-preview sample link in FRENCH on the LIVE account (hostbay@moxx.co). Logged in via /auth/login (note: /login is a 404 route), switched account language to FR via /settings?section=profile, loaded /storefront?tab=page and asserted every in-scope string. ALL in-scope items render in French with 0 raw key leaks and 0 console errors. Account language was restored to 'en' and verified with /app/tests/verify_language_en.py (LANGUAGE = en, PASS).

verified_french_renders.subtitle: Votre page Dynopay — pourboires, produits et liens de paiement derrière un seul lien.
verified_french_renders.storefront-company-hint: Modification de la vitrine de hostbay (company name rendered in a styled <span> with fontWeight 700 -> visually bold; NO literal '<b>' text in DOM). Note: b/strong tag count is 0 because the Trans component maps 'b' to a MUI Box span - expected, not a defect.

out_of_scope_english_observed: CreatorPageSettings (data-testid=creator-settings): helper text '(shown at the top of your public page)' still hardcoded English; also the row actions Edit / Copy / QR / View next to the public URL.
StorefrontComparePanel (data-testid=storefront-compare-panel): 'Compare storefronts' heading and 'No storefront yet' row label still hardcoded English.
Buyer-facing widget defaults ('Support me') intentionally untranslated - not flagged.
action_items: No blocking issues for this round. Optional next i18n pass: wrap CreatorPageSettings helper text '(shown at the top of your public page)' + Edit/Copy/QR/View actions and StorefrontComparePanel strings ('Compare storefronts', 'No storefront yet').
critical_code_review_comments: All 6 locales (en/pt/fr/es/de/nl) contain the same 23 storefront.* keys - verified by key-set diff, no missing keys.
Every t() call in the touched components carries a defaultValue, so a missing key would degrade to English rather than leaking a raw key - good practice.
seed_data_creation: none - read-only verification against LIVE DB; only the account language field was toggled fr -> en and restored.

Language switch persists to the LIVE account; ALWAYS restore to en at the end and assert with `python3 /app/tests/verify_language_en.py`. Remaining untranslated storefront strings: creator-settings helper text/row actions, storefront-compare-panel, Products & Share tab bodies.
